description.p: Rico Plus discovers, edits, views, and organizes RTF documents across registered workspaces.
It combines a Ribbon-based rich-text editor with folder dashboards, view-only opening, drag-and-drop organization, and asynchronous scanning.
Canonical release closing the 0.0.3 experimental line, including the finalized workspace-command layout and main Dashboard touchscreen panning.
Moves Launch New Window directly below Manage Workspaces and assigns Ctrl+Alt+Shift+N.
Restored Ricopad-style touchscreen drag/pan on the persistent Rico Plus Ribbon using Qt QScroller touch gesture arbitration.
Softens the explicit Light theme to the approved neutral-gray palette while leaving System and Dark themes unchanged.
Moves Focused Mode immediately before Locked Mode in the View menu while retaining the separator after Locked Mode.
Restores F3 to Find Next, maps Ctrl+Shift+L to Bullet List, relocates unbound Launch New Window, and completes the keyboard-shortcuts catalogue including nested formatting commands.
Assigns F3 to New Window and removes the conflicting F3 assignment from Find Next.
Remaps Font to Ctrl+Shift+F and adds Ctrl+Shift+] / Ctrl+Shift+[ for font-size increase and decrease.
Renames Show File Header to File Header and assigns Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F to toggle it, transferring that shortcut from Font to avoid ambiguity.
Swaps the Ribbon positions of Zoom In and Zoom Out; no other functional change.
Removes expensive live word counting, reorders the compact editor status fields, and normalizes the runtime desktop identity to rico-plus.
Refines the editor status layout by pinning zoom at the far right, restoring Dark Editor feedback to the editor status field, and routing App Theme feedback to the main application status bar.
Stabilizes the editor status bar: removes the duplicated filepath, adds word count, reserves fixed statistic widths, and makes status messages horizontally elastic.
Renames Lock Editor/Collapsed Mode to Locked Mode/Focused Mode and opens locked documents at the top to match Marko Plus behavior.
Adds Marko Plus-style F2 folder rename parity while retaining safe document rename behavior and protecting the Workspace root.
Replaces unsafe Keep My Version handling with Save Version As, preserving externally changed source files while saving the Rico editor version to a different path.
Restores proactive external-change warnings for open RTF documents, with safe Reload/Keep semantics independent of File Header visibility.
Adopts the Marko Plus staged closing workflow with responsive shutdown progress, scanner cancellation, and optional shutdown timing diagnostics.
Removes the obsolete duplicate RtfEditorWindow implementation so Rico Plus has one live Ricopad-derived QWidget editor host.
Restores Ricopad-style programmatic New File creation; workspace documents no longer depend on a bundled RTF template.
Experimental Marko-pattern editor-surface integration rebase.
Unified status visibility, persistent file-header visibility, and AppMenu-only Collapsed Mode.
Restores Marko-style file headings, fixes live theme/editor-theme synchronization, refines Rico icon-family selectors, and makes the existing Rico canvas focus accent persistent.
Restores the full first-time tutorial wizard, adds the missing Rico theme/icon selector artwork, and synchronizes editor appearance with App Theme until explicitly overridden.
Fixes persistent Plasma global-menu ownership, persistent Lock Editor behavior, and the specified appmenu/shortcut corrections.
Restores Plasma global-menu export, shortcut-bearing Ribbon tooltips, New Window, F4 Properties, and the approved File/Configure Ribbon arrangements.
Restores desktop global-menu integration and relabels Editor Icons to App Icons.
Rebases menu, Ribbon, shortcut, and command ownership onto one persistent Plus shell while retaining Ricopad as the RTF document engine.
Restores the full-width managed-workspace Ribbon, fixes shortcut ownership, and clears saved sidebar state immediately.
Corrects embedded editor visibility and adds rendered-interface regression coverage.
Rico Plus 0.0.1 source release.
